title: Outside My Season
caption:
Outside My Season

Personal colour analysis is everywhere now —
in Japan, and increasingly across Asia.
As a makeup artist, I seldom reach for it.

By its rules, my skin would be read
as Spring, perhaps Autumn.
Still, there are days I wear Winter:
vivid shades, cool and edged with blue.

Makeup is not only the art of colours
that disappear into the skin.
A shade that seems to sit apart from it,
placed with intention,
can make a face unforgettable.
That, for me, is the pleasure of it.

This is the quiet magic of colour,
and I would like more people to know it.

For a first session, though,
I rarely take anyone too far, too soon.
